about.about: I am an undergraduate currently obtaining a B.S. in Computer Science at University of California, Riverside. I am seeking any opportunities to apply and leverage my skill set in sofware development. I have experience with full-stack frameworks (React, Vue, TypeScript, Node, Express, Mongo, REST API, GraphQL, Laravel). Additionally, I have worked extensively with machine learning and big data stacks (Python, TensorFlow, Pytorch, Jupyter, Selenium). I also enjoy meeting new peers and working in collaborative team environements. My interpersonal skill set includes collaboration, communication, critical thinking, creativity, and time management. .Let's work together to bring your ideas to life! On a more personal note, I was born in Seattle, WA and grew up in Irvine, CA. My hobbies include surfing, tennis, skiing, cinema and coding
